$comment: The lore map (mw-e39.13, bible 7.1: three sources that disagree). For each major canon fact, the in-world sources that speak of it: a book, an object (note or inscription) and a person (dialogue), each at least once and at least three in all. `pattern` is a case-insensitive regular expression the source's text must match, so a source cannot be listed without actually mentioning the fact. lore-map.test.ts checks it (AC-4).

long-vespers.label: The Long Vespers: the night the bell was silenced and the priory walked into the Knot
long-vespers.pattern: long vespers|bell stopped|matter at bellwater|take out the tongue

horn.label: Horn's role: the Warden of the Knot, who stays awake so the valley can sleep

bell.label: The Vesper Bell: rung at dusk, its note quiets what sleeps below
